ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: The figure is a transition-state structure, with the left and right sides roughly symmetrical; at the left end there is an “NC” group connected to a substituted carbon, this substituted carbon has two linear substituents, and is connected to the left nitrogen; in the middle is an N=N unit; the right nitrogen is connected to another similar substituted carbon, this carbon also has two linear substituents, and is connected to the right-end “CN” group. There are also curved arrows in the figure, but the problem requires ignoring the arrows. Then reason: Count only the bonds between non-hydrogen atoms, and count each single bond, double bond, and triple bond as one bond. Counting from left to right: 1 internal N–C bond in the left-end NC; 1 bond from this C to the adjacent substituted carbon; 2 bonds from the left substituted carbon to the two linear substituents; 1 bond from the left substituted carbon to the left N; 1 central N=N bond; 1 bond from the right N to the right substituted carbon; 2 bonds from the right substituted carbon to the two linear substituents; 1 bond from the right substituted carbon to the CN carbon; 1 internal C–N bond in the right-end CN. The total number is 1 + 1 + 2 + 1 + 1 + 1 + 2 + 1 + 1 = 11.

<image_1> In the transition-state structure shown in the image, calculate the total number of bonds in the structure, including single, double, and triple bonds but excluding those involving hydrogen.

method.method_draft: Describe the image first: it shows a transition-state drawing with a left NC group attached to a substituted carbon, a central N=N unit, and a mirrored substituted carbon attached to a CN group on the right, plus curved arrows. Ignore the arrows. Starting at the left end, count one N–C bond in NC, one bond from that C to the adjacent substituted carbon, two bonds from that substituted carbon to its two line substituents, one bond from that carbon to the left N, one central N=N bond, one bond from the right N to the right substituted carbon, two bonds from that carbon to its two line substituents, one bond from that carbon to the CN carbon, and one C–N bond in CN. Sum these counted heavy-atom bonds to get 11.

再推理：只数非氢原子之间的键，并把单键、双键、三键各作为一个键来计数。按从左到右计数：左端 NC 内部 N–C 键 1 个；该 C 到相邻取代碳的键 1 个；左侧取代碳到两条线形取代基的键 2 个；左侧取代碳到左侧 N 的键 1 个；中央 N=N 键 1 个；右侧 N 到右侧取代碳的键 1 个；右侧取代碳到两条线形取代基的键 2 个；右侧取代碳到 CN 碳的键 1 个；右端 CN 内部 C–N 键 1 个。总数为 1 + 1 + 2 + 1 + 1 + 1 + 2 + 1 + 1 = 11。
